newsitem.title: USA: Aluminum stockpile delay due to inventory checks.
newsitem.headline: Aluminum stockpile delay due to inventory checks.

text.p: U.S. Defense National Stockpile center attributed the delay in the aluminum sale to inventory checks following the quick sale of the previous material, a spokesman told Reuters.
The stockpile has sold approximately 53,000 short tons in monthly increments in the last five months and has about 9,800 short tons remaining.
"We sold the material so quickly, we wanted a chance to go in and take a quick inventory check," the stockpile spokesman said.
The sale was originally slated for Sept 2, but was postponned until Oct 7, Stockpile announced earlier.
((Derek J. Caney, New York Commodity Desk, 212-859-1646))
